SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
S.1, Special Branch 72
REPORT    Date June 22, 1939.
Subject The China Hellenic Lines, Limited.
Made by D.S. Lockwood.    Forwarded by

On June 17, 1939, a notice was published in
the North China Daily News to the effect that Mr. E.
KERMODE and Mr. N.N. MALINOVSKY had been appointed
Manager and Assistant Manager of the China Hellenic
Lines, Limited, Messageries Maritimes Building,
No.9 Quai France. Both of the above mentioned
persons were former employees of the Moller Associated
Companies.

During the course of an interview with Mr. J.W.
CREIGHTON, H.B.M. acting Shipping Consul, it was
ascertained that the founders of the China Hellenic
Lines, Ltd., had submitted an application to be
registered under the Hongkong ordinances. In view of
the fact that all conditions required under the China
"Orders in Council" had been complied with the request
was granted. The following data is recorded in the
"register of shares" return.

Capital C.$50,000.    Shares C.$10.- each.

Directors
Mr. FREDERICK SAMUEL GODFREY, British,    50 shares
Mrs. ROBERTINA BARRETT,    "    50    "
Mr. E.P. YANNOULATOS, Greek.    50    "

No shares have been placed for sale on the public market.

It is reported that the above mentioned concern
will act as general shipping agents for a number of
vessels, which will sail under the Greek Flag.

H. S. Lockwood
D. S.

D.C.(Special Branch).

（左侧批注：FILE）
（左侧手写符号：C 2/3 %）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号...........
S.1，特务科 72
报告    日期 1939年6月22日。
事由 中国希腊轮船有限公司（China Hellenic Lines, Limited）。
制作人 D.S. Lockwood。    呈报人

1939年6月17日，《字林西报》刊登了一则通告，大意是 E. KERMODE 先生和 N.N. MALINOVSKY 先生已被任命为位于法租界法兰西外滩9号邮船公司大楼（Messageries Maritimes Building）的中国希腊轮船有限公司的经理和副经理。上述两人此前均系茂勒联营公司（Moller Associated Companies）的雇员。

在与英国驻华代理航运领事 J.W. CREIGHTON 先生的会谈过程中，获悉中国希腊轮船有限公司的创始人已提交申请，要求根据香港条例进行注册。鉴于该公司已符合中国“枢密院令”（Orders in Council）所规定的所有条件，该请求已获批准。“股份登记册”回执中记录了以下数据。

资本 国币50,000元。    每股 国币10元。

董事
FREDERICK SAMUEL GODFREY 先生，英籍，    50股
ROBERTINA BARRETT 女士，    "    50    "
E.P. YANNOULATOS 先生，希腊籍。    50    "

未有股份在公开市场上出售。

据报，上述商行将作为多家悬挂希腊国旗航行船只的总航运代理。

H. S. Lockwood
D. S.

副督察（特务科）。

（左侧批注：归档）
（左侧手写符号：C 2/3 %）

NOTICE

THE SHIPPING PUBLIC IS HEREBY
NOTIFIED that Mr. E. KERMODE has
resigned his position as Secretary to
the Moller Associated Companies, and
Mr. N. N. MALINOVSKY has re-
signed his position as Head of the
Chartering Department of Moller
Line, Limited.

Effective as from June 15, 1939,
Mr. E. KERMODE and Mr. N. N.
MALINOVSKY have been appointed
Manager and Assistant Manager re-
spectively of the CHINA HELLENIC
LINES, LIMITED.

NOTICE

We have pleasure in announcing
that, as from June 15, 1939, Mr.
E. KERMODE has joined our Board
of Directors and has been appointed
Manager of the Company, and are
further pleased to announce that Mr.
N. N. MALINOVSKY has been ap-
pointed Assistant Manager of the
Company.

《字林西报》。

1939年6月17日

通告

兹通知航运界各界人士，E. KERMODE 先生已辞去其在茂勒联营公司担任的秘书职务，N. N. MALINOVSKY 先生已辞去其在茂勒轮船有限公司（Moller Line, Limited）租船部主管的职务。

自1939年6月15日起，E. KERMODE 先生和 N. N. MALINOVSKY 先生分别被任命为中国希腊轮船有限公司的经理和副经理。

通告

我们很高兴地宣布，自1939年6月15日起，E. KERMODE 先生已加入本公司董事会，并被任命为公司经理；此外，我们亦很高兴地宣布，N. N. MALINOVSKY 先生已被任命为公司副经理。
